A gold ability is one the archetype trained hard — an Ogre Bruiser's Strength, a Mage's Intelligence. Every talent below is a real talent a player can pick, so a monster is just a character the DM didn't have to build by hand.
Decide Your Own Path — Great Beasts Nine tailed beasts, one per terrain — levels 41–89
Reading a sheet. Every ability is measured against a human, whose scores sit at 10. The bar under each score shows how far above or below human the creature is.
stronger than human
weaker than human
A gold ability is Strength and Charisma in every case — raw mass and raw will, in that order. Read the Sealing block first. None of these nine can be killed — the campaign question is who is going to carry it afterwards.
Decide Your Own Path — Liches Liches, death knights & demiliches — levels 26–88
Reading a sheet. Every ability is measured against a human, whose scores sit at 10. The bar under each score shows how far above or below human the creature is.
stronger than human
weaker than human
A gold ability is Intelligence for the liches and Strength for the death knights — the two halves of the family. Read the Phylactery block first. Every fight in this section is unwinnable until the party has done something about the anchor.
Decide Your Own Path — Celestials Archons, angels & the fallen — levels 12–80
Reading a sheet. Every ability is measured against a human, whose scores sit at 10. The bar under each score shows how far above or below human the creature is.
stronger than human
weaker than human
A gold ability is usually Wisdom or Charisma — celestials cast from conviction, and hit remarkably hard besides. These are the compendium's source of radiant damage and its only source of healing — far more useful pointed at your undead problem than fought directly.
Decide Your Own Path — Fey Courts, hags & archfey — levels 5–85
Reading a sheet. Every ability is measured against a human, whose scores sit at 10. The bar under each score shows how far above or below human the creature is.
stronger than human
weaker than human
A gold ability is nearly always Charisma — fey win by charm, glamour and the exact wording of a promise. Bring cold iron, and bring someone who listens carefully. A fey cannot lie, so a precise question always gets a true answer — just not a helpful one.
Decide Your Own Path — Elementals Fire, water, earth & air — seven tiers, levels 6–70
Reading a sheet. Every ability is measured against a human, whose scores sit at 10. The bar under each score shows how far above or below human the creature is.
stronger than human
weaker than human
A gold ability tells you how the element fights — Dexterity for air and fire, Strength and Constitution for earth and water. Bring the opposing element. Cold for fire, lightning for water, thunder for earth — these are the two damage types the rest of this compendium barely uses, and here they are the answer.
Decide Your Own Path — Constructs Made things — levels 6–72
Reading a sheet. Every ability is measured against a human, whose scores sit at 10. The bar under each score shows how far above or below human the creature is.
stronger than human
weaker than human
A gold ability is Strength or Constitution — note how low the mental scores run, and how few talents that leaves the mindless ones. Bring a magical weapon or do not come at all: golems and colossi take nothing from ordinary steel. Lightning drops a colossus fastest; an antimagic field switches an animated object off entirely.
Decide Your Own Path — Fiends Devils & demons — levels 8–80
Reading a sheet. Every ability is measured against a human, whose scores sit at 10. The bar under each score shows how far above or below human the creature is.
stronger than human
weaker than human
A gold ability is Charisma for devils, who talk first, and Strength for demons, who do not. These fill the gap above level 55 that only ancient dragons occupied. A Pit Fiend (58), a Balor (62), an Archduke (75) and a Demon Lord (80) are all campaign finales in their own right.
Decide Your Own Path — Aberrations Minds from outside — levels 12–52
Reading a sheet. Every ability is measured against a human, whose scores sit at 10. The bar under each score shows how far above or below human the creature is.
stronger than human
weaker than human
A gold ability is almost always Intelligence here — these things fight with their minds and are frequently feeble in body. Plan around saving throws, not armour. Every headline ability in this section ignores AC — and an Elder Brain with Strength 8 will still end a party that fails its first Intelligence save.
Decide Your Own Path — Driders Cursed drow, levels 24–48 — outcast to ascendant
Reading a sheet. Every ability is measured against a human, whose scores sit at 10. The bar under each score shows how far above or below human the creature is.
stronger than human
weaker than human
A gold ability is what the drider leans on — Dexterity for the outcasts, Wisdom for the goddess's chosen. Every drider was a drow first. Sunlight Sensitivity is still the lever — fight them in the open and they lose half their advantage; fight them in their webs and you are on their ground.
Decide Your Own Path — Vampires Spawn to Lord — the Lord is level 54
Reading a sheet. Every ability is measured against a human, whose scores sit at 10. The bar under each score shows how far above or below human the creature is.
stronger than human
weaker than human
A gold ability is what the vampire leans on — Charisma for the noble strain, Strength for the feral. Read the Weaknesses block before the Damage defenses one: sunlight, running water, the invitation rule and the coffin are how these die. Damage alone does not do it.
Decide Your Own Path — Shadows Half-real things — all of them resist physical damage

stronger than human

A gold ability is what the shadow leans on — Dexterity for the stalkers, Charisma for the shades. Check the Damage defenses block on every sheet before you plan the fight: steel is halved against all of these, and radiant is the lever.
Decide Your Own Path — Zombies The risen dead — d12 hit dice, no Constitution bonus
Reading a sheet. Every ability is measured against a human, whose scores sit at 10. The bar under each score shows how far above or below human the creature is.
stronger than human
weaker than human
A gold ability is the one thing the corpse still does well — almost always Strength or Constitution. Zombies are Intelligence 3: they qualify for almost nothing. What they have is Toughness, Iron Veins and bulk — and Undead Fortitude, which is why they keep standing back up.

Decide Your Own Path — Dragons (Metallic) Five metallics, weakest to strongest — brass · copper · bronze · silver · gold
Reading a sheet. Every ability is measured against a human, whose scores sit at 10. The bar under each score shows how far above or below human the creature is.
stronger than human
weaker than human
A gold ability is one the dragon leans on — a gold's Charisma, a bronze's Strength. The tabs on each sheet are ages, not roles: pick a wyrmling for a first dragon, an ancient to end a campaign. Breath is cast from the mana pool, so a dragon that has spent its mana is a very different fight.

A gold ability is one the dragon leans on — a red's Strength and Charisma, a green's Intelligence. The tabs on each sheet are ages, not roles: pick a wyrmling for a first dragon, an ancient to end a campaign. Breath is cast from the mana pool, so a dragon that has spent its mana is a very different fight.
Decide Your Own Path — Magical Beasts Animals by habitat · statted on the same rules as the Character Builder
Reading a stat block. Each ability is measured against a human, whose scores sit at 10; the bar under each score shows how far above or below a person the animal is — a bear's Strength towers, its Intelligence barely registers.
bonded beasts make good ranger companions, familiar ones suit the Animal Companion talent's familiar, and mount beasts can be ridden.
Every sheet lists the proficiency a druid needs to slip into that shape via Wild Form, so this doubles as a companion & shapeshift picker.
